description: Batch US address geocoder (up to 10) — Geocode up to 10 one-line US street addresses in one call (addresses separated by | or ;) with the US Census Bureau geocoder: matched address, lat/lon, city, state, ZIP and MATCH / AMBIGUOUS / NO_MATCH status for each, plus the centroid, bounding box and farthest pair (miles) of the matched points. Public-domain data. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
